description: Asks the seller of an item on agentPickup's marketplace a question before buying: is it still available, its condition, sizes, whether it fits. Opens a private conversation between the person and the seller, shown as a card; the seller gets an email if they don't read it soon. Contact details, other apps and links aren't shared until the person buys, and payment only goes through agentPickup. The seller is emailed if they don't read it within a couple of minutes; their answer appears in this conversation (open_deal) and the person is emailed when it arrives. Send only what the person asked, in their words. Needs sign-in.

text.description: The question, in the person's words.

name: ask_seller
title: Ask the seller a question
